newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ANZ BANK SAYS TO LEAD MANAGE CHH CP ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ANZ BANK SAYS TO LEAD MANAGE CHH CP ISSUE.

text.p: ANZ Investment Bank said on Thursday it had been mandated to arrange and lead manage a NZ$400 million New Zealand and Australia dollar "multi option facility" for Carter Holt Harvey Ltd.

Under the facility, Carter Holt can issue commercial paper in the New Zealand and Australian domestic markets for up to a total of NZ$400 million. The facility also allows for the issue of medium term notes in either Australian or New Zealand dollars.
ANZ Investment Bank managing director John Sunderland said the mandate was a further significant step in the expansion of the corporate bond market in Australia and New Zealand.
The New Zealand dealer panel for the facility is ANZ Investment Bank, Bank of New Zealand, National Bank of New Zealand and WestpacTrust.
The Australian dealer panel is ANZ Investment Bank, National Australia Bank and Westpac.
Carter Holt has a Standard and Poor's long term credit rating of BBB+ and a short term credit rating of A-2.
